When is the best time to plant rice in Cambodia?

How do I make compost at home?

Mix 'greens' (vegetable scraps, fruit peels, fresh grass) with 'browns' (dry leaves, rice straw, cardboard) in a bin or pile. Keep it damp like a squeezed sponge and turn it every week or two. In a hot climate it's ready in about 1–3 months, when it's dark and smells like soil. Don't add meat, oil or dairy.

Tell me about the Mekong River.

The Mekong is about 4,900 km long, one of the world's great rivers. It starts on the Tibetan Plateau and flows through China, Myanmar, Laos, Thailand, Cambodia and Vietnam. In Cambodia it meets the Tonlé Sap and Bassac rivers at Phnom Penh (the **Chaktomuk**, or 'four faces'), and it supports huge fisheries and rice farming.
